traits.name: GM Approval
traits.effect: Smart AIs require GM approval due to their power and narrative impact.

traits.name: Stationed
traits.effect: A Smart AI must be installed in a Station such as a computer system or advanced armor like Mjolnir.

traits.name: No Specialization Pack
traits.effect: Smart AIs do not choose Specialization Packs. Instead, they begin with four Skills at +10, which act as their specialization.

traits.name: Educated
traits.effect: Begins with 3 Educations at +10 and has no limit on how many Educations can be learned.

traits.name: Limited Abilities
traits.effect: Many Skills and Abilities do not function for Smart AIs due to lacking a physical body.

traits.name: AI Combat
traits.effect: Smart AIs begin with Wounds representing stability. Attacks represent digital combat using Strength and Warfare Characteristics.

traits.name: Language
traits.effect: Begins with all Human and Misc. languages. Learns all Covenant languages after 2530, and all Forerunner languages after 2553.

traits.name: Lifespan
traits.effect: Smart AIs have a 7-year lifespan. After year 7, they must roll monthly Toughness Tests; failure causes permanent -5 Wounds and -5 Toughness.

traits.name: Connectivity
traits.effect: May connect to Human technology without rolls. Connecting to Covenant tech is at -10. Connecting to Forerunner tech is at -20.

insurrectionist_rules.weapon_cost_increase: Weapons without the [I] tag cost 25% more.
insurrectionist_rules.modification_discount: Weapon and Vehicle Modifications cost half cR.

special_rules.station_requirement: Smart AIs must be installed in a Station to operate.
special_rules.destabilization: After 7 years active, monthly Toughness Tests determine stability loss.

none: Smart AIs do not possess physical equipment unless installed in a system or armor.
